media.title: Media library
media.description: Images uploaded here can be used as covers or inside articles.
media.uploadDescription: JPEG, PNG, or WebP up to 10 MB. The image is resized and its metadata removed.
media.dropHere: Drop an image here or click to choose
media.fileHint: JPEG, PNG, or WebP · max 10 MB
media.altHint: Describe the image for screen readers and search engines (required).
media.altPlaceholder: e.g. Architecture diagram of the payment flow
media.searchPlaceholder: Search by alt text or file name…
media.emptyDescription: Upload your first image to start building the library.
media.emptyPickerDescription: No image matches. Upload a new one from the Upload tab.
media.pickerDescription: Pick an image from the library or upload a new one.
media.confirmDelete: Delete this image? This cannot be undone.

errors.type: Only JPEG, PNG, or WebP images are allowed.
errors.size: The image is larger than 10 MB.
errors.invalid: The image could not be read. Try another file.

taxonomy.name: Name
taxonomy.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Changing it changes the public URL.
taxonomy.createDescription: Give it a name. The slug is generated from the name if you leave it empty.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Every article belongs to exactly one category.
categories.emptyDescription: Create a category before publishing your first article.
categories.deleteDescription: The category will be removed. This cannot be undone.
categories.deleteInUse_one: {{count}} article still uses this category. Move it to another category first.
categories.deleteInUse_other: {{count}} articles still use this category. Move them to another category first.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: An article can have many tags.
tags.emptyDescription: Create tags to label your articles.
tags.deleteDescription_one: The tag will be removed from {{count}} article. This cannot be undone.
tags.deleteDescription_other: The tag will be removed from {{count}} articles. This cannot be undone.

errors.nameTooLong: Name must be at most 80 characters.
errors.slugTooLong: Slug must be at most 120 characters.
errors.slugFormat: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single hyphens.
